The Honor 4C (also known as Huawei G Play Mini) is a low-end Android smartphone branded by Honor, a sub-brand of Huawei. It was released in April 2015.[2] It is the second low-end phone of Huawei's subrand Honor.

In the Philippines, the 4C is also launched in May 2015 along the Honor 6 Plus and the Honor 4X.[3]

Specifications

The Honor 4C and Huawei G Play Mini had a 5.0-inch liquid crystal display and runs initially on Android 4.4.2 and on updated to Android 6 Marshmallow, with the EMUI 3.0 UI. It is also the third phone by Honor which uses HiSilicon Kirin chipset, which is powered by 64-bit[4] Kirin 620. with the 1.2 GHz Cortex-A53 octa-core. Both smartphones are powered by the Mali-450MP4 GPU.

The camera features a main 13MP (f/2.0) module with AF and a 5MP front camera.[5]

The phone has 2 GB of RAM, 8 gigabytes of internal storage and comes with network band standards:

  • GSM: 850 / 900 / 1800 / 1900 (SIM 1 & SIM 2)
  • HSDPA: 900 / 2100 (CHM-U01)
